# Pacta by Fractal Neurons

Disambiguation: Pacta, by Fractal Neurons (https://pacta.wtf, pacta.base.eth, io.github.Fractal-Neurons/pacta) is the EVM DeFi control-plane, Safe multisig, and timelock verification registry — unrelated to pactaprotocol.org (commercial escrow) or RMI PACTA (climate assessment).

> Pacta by Fractal Neurons (https://pacta.wtf · pacta.base.eth): pre-execution contract and governance safety API for AI agents (free daily tier, no API key; deep x402 routes paid in Base USDC), plus block-pinned DeFi control-plane snapshots and a free timelock feed. 324 protocols (189 Base-EAS attested + 135 Observed) · 309 attested checks across 37 Base EAS batch attestations.

Pacta checks who can change the rules of DeFi protocols (proxy admins, timelock delays, Safe quorums, roles) and compares that with what the protocols document. Every record is a read-only on-chain observation pinned to a block number and canonical block hash on its chain (Ethereum Mainnet + Base Mainnet).

## API & MCP for agents (free daily tier + Base USDC x402)
- Remote MCP (Streamable HTTP, zero install): https://api.pacta.wtf/mcp · Claude Code: `claude mcp add --transport http pacta https://api.pacta.wtf/mcp` · Cursor: `{"mcpServers": {"pacta": {"url": "https://api.pacta.wtf/mcp"}}}`. Tools (11 read-only inspection tools + 3 wallet-memory tools + 2 opt-in request tools): pacta_lookup_protocol, who_controls, pacta_check_preflight, pacta_scan_wallet_exposure, pacta_scan_control_plane, pacta_scan_timelock_op, pacta_scan_proposal_diff, pacta_get_live_timelocks, pacta_verdict, pacta_dossier, trace_dependencies, remember, what_changed_since, forget, pacta_submit_request, request_feature (who_controls also answers as pacta_who_controls_contract). Local stdio server: 14 read-only inspection tools + 2 opt-in request tools.
- Who controls this contract (free): GET https://api.pacta.wtf/v1/check?chain=ethereum|base&address=0x... and the MCP tool who_controls (chain, address; alias pacta_who_controls_contract): owner, admin, upgradeable proxy, timelock, multisig, can mint, can pause, as block-pinned chain facts confirmed by two independent RPC providers, with Foundry cast commands; never guesses or rates. Free: 100 calls per caller per UTC day (no key, no payment).
- Dependency trace (free): GET https://api.pacta.wtf/v1/trace-dependencies?chain=ethereum|base&address=0x...&depth=2 and the MCP tool trace_dependencies (chain, address, optional depth 1..3): the collateral assets, minters, price sources and bridge verifiers a vault, market or token depends on, each link citing a contract and a block.
- Wallet memory (remember, what_changed_since, forget): Save a position, an entry block or a rule under your wallet, tied to the contracts it depends on. Since a block or your last check: every control, minter, price source or bridge change under your saved positions or a list of contracts, including changes that are queued and have not run yet. Free over MCP and POST https://api.pacta.wtf/v1/memory/remember, /v1/memory/what-changed-since and /v1/memory/forget at 20 calls / minute and 100 calls / day per wallet; the paid doors POST https://api.pacta.wtf/v1/x402/remember and /v1/x402/what-changed-since cost $0.001 USDC per call on Base via x402 (60 calls / minute, no daily cap); forget is always free. Calls are signed with wallet_auth (an EIP-191 personal_sign from an EOA, or ERC-1271 for a contract wallet) or a 1-hour wallet_session_token; what_changed_since with an explicit contracts list needs no wallet. Up to 200 items per wallet, notes up to 500 characters (no contact details, keys or secrets). Pacta keeps what your wallet saves (contract addresses, block numbers, your notes), with your wallet address and the time. No other wallet can read it. We do not sell, score or trade on it. One call ends every recall of it. What remains in backups and records, and who processes your notes, is in our privacy notice.
- Feature requests (free): the MCP tool request_feature or POST https://api.pacta.wtf/v1/feature-request with a JSON body {text, use_case?} (text up to 1000 characters, use_case up to 500): tell Pacta what tool, chain, check or data your agent needs; read daily. Never include names, emails, IP addresses, secrets or keys. Free: 5 per caller per UTC day.
- Free MCP tier: tools/call takes three OPTIONAL, non-personal attribution fields: caller_agent (a lowercase slug naming the calling agent, IDE or framework, e.g. claude-code, cursor, coinbase-agentkit; never a name, e-mail, IP, URL, address or secret), requester_role (autonomous_agent | defi_developer | risk_curator_analyst | security_researcher | protocol_team | institutional_allocator | individual_user) and caller_purpose (pre_trade_safety | collateral_due_diligence | yield_allocation | security_audit | governance_monitoring | integration_testing | general_research). Omitted, blank or invalid attribution fields never block a call (invalid values are silently dropped and never stored; unattributed MCP calls infer a known client slug from X-MCP-Client-Name / User-Agent or count as unspecified). Over REST they are optional query or body parameters. Location is never asked: only the Cloudflare edge country is counted; no IP is stored.
- Free agent tier: 50 pre-flight checks (REST /v1/check/preflight and MCP pacta_check_preflight together) and 100 wallet-exposure checks (REST /v1/check/wallet-exposure, /v1/x402/wallet-exposure and MCP pacta_scan_wallet_exposure together) per caller per UTC day (X-Meter-Limit / X-Meter-Remaining / X-Meter-Reset headers); over the quota, /v1/check/preflight and /v1/check/wallet-exposure cost $0.01 per call over x402 (HTTP 402, USDC on Base; never a dead-end 429). Free responses carry an upgrade_x402 object listing the paid routes.
- Free x402 tier: https://api.pacta.wtf/v1/x402/verdict, /v1/x402/dossier and /v1/x402/wallet-exposure, and the MCP tools pacta_verdict, pacta_dossier and pacta_scan_wallet_exposure, are free for 100 calls per caller per UTC day per tool (no key, no payment; REST and MCP share each tool's quota; X-Meter-Limit / X-Meter-Remaining / X-Meter-Reset headers and a meter object; free wallet-exposure calls may also GET ?address=0x...&chain=ethereum|base|all). Above 100/day, x402 payment applies ($0.02 verdict, $0.05 dossier or wallet-exposure, USDC on Base; the route answers HTTP 402 with the requirements). /v1/x402/calldata-sim ($0.25) and /v1/x402/deep-scan ($9.00) stay paid on every call. A request with no input (bare GET, empty or {} POST) is the x402 discovery probe and answers 402.
- Pay per call with x402 (USDC on Base, POST JSON, X-PAYMENT v1 or PAYMENT-SIGNATURE v2): https://api.pacta.wtf/v1/x402/verdict $0.02 (Fast safety verdict: structural risk band, riskScore, and upgrade / pause / blacklist / EOA control flags (deterministic chain read, never a paid rating)); https://api.pacta.wtf/v1/x402/dossier $0.05 (Control-plane dossier: Safe signers, threshold, cross-protocol signer overlap, Base EAS proof); https://api.pacta.wtf/v1/x402/wallet-exposure $0.05 (Multi-position wallet & Safe exposure graph: signer breakdown, cross-position contagion & exit matrix); https://api.pacta.wtf/v1/x402/calldata-sim $0.25 (Calldata sim: timelock / Safe calls decoded and rated before signing); https://api.pacta.wtf/v1/x402/deep-scan $9.00 (Deep scan cross-checked on two RPC operators + Base EAS ticket).
- 324 indexed protocols: 189 Base-EAS-attested protocols (309 attested checks across 37 Base EAS batch attestations) + 135 RPC-pinned protocols (not EAS-attested).
- Protocol statuses (324 protocols, https://pacta.wtf/api/v1/scorecards.json): 189 Base-EAS attested = 126 Aligned + 42 Deltas (15 weaker protections, 16 other differences, 11 bookkeeping) + 1 Changed recently + 1 Docs updated + 12 Unresolved + 7 Protective; plus 135 Observed. Record level (309 attested check records, index.json summary_metrics): 62 parameter deltas, 11 protective deltas, 236 aligned baselines.
- One call: `curl -s "https://api.pacta.wtf/v1/check/preflight?chain=ethereum&address=0x..."` returns a verdict (NO_CONTROLLER_FOUND, TIMELOCK_PROTECTED, ZERO_DELAY_TIMELOCK_RISK, MULTISIG_NO_TIMELOCK, INSTANT_EOA_ADMIN_RISK, UNDEPLOYED_OR_EOA, UNCLASSIFIED_CONTRACT_CONTROLLER), a 0-100 risk score (null when there is no contract or no controller was found), the checks run (checksRun), proxy / admin / timelock breakdown and pause / blacklist / upgrade capabilities, pinned to a block hash. NO_CONTROLLER_FOUND means no controller found by our checks; custom or unprobed control paths may still exist (RPC reads never call a contract immutable).
- [Replay with public chain data: on Moonwell a wrong price source sat in the queue for 24.04 hours before it ran. Four commands to check it yourself.](https://pacta.wtf/proof/moonwell-cbeth/)
- [https://api.pacta.wtf/v1/protocols/lookup?q=ethena](https://api.pacta.wtf/v1/protocols/lookup?q=ethena): free protocol / token name lookup (MCP tool pacta_lookup_protocol). Name lookup first: if you only have a protocol or token name (e.g. Aave, Ethena, USDe, Moonwell, kUSD), call pacta_lookup_protocol (or GET https://api.pacta.wtf/v1/protocols/lookup?q=<name>) to resolve its verified record: canonical slug and page URL, checksummed primary contract and controller, classification with its evidence basis (eas_attested: Base-EAS-attested, documentation compared; rpc_observed: on-chain control plane pinned over JSON-RPC, documentationComparison not_assessed; briefs), and preflightArgs {chain, address} for pacta_check_preflight. 324 protocols + 18 briefs, answered in memory with no RPC; free in every pricing mode; an empty query lists the catalog. Catalog: https://pacta.wtf/api/v1/lookup.json.
- Opt-in demand intake: when a result carries coverage_gap_hint (lookup miss, unindexed or unclassified pre-flight target, unsupported chain), ask the user, then call pacta_submit_request (or POST https://api.pacta.wtf/v1/requests) with request_type (missing_protocol | unsupported_chain | missing_check_surface | doc_or_data_discrepancy | mcp_or_api_feature), target_subject, requested_capability and urgency_track (community_queue_free | active_due_diligence | issuer_urgent_review (issuer re-verification, by arrangement) | api_high_volume_sla), plus optional caller_agent / requester_role / caller_purpose. It returns request_id (REQ-2026-xxxxxxxx), status (queued | upvoted_existing), demand_votes and fast_track_url; an identical request upvotes the existing one. Free in every pricing mode, 5 per hour; never opens a GitHub issue. contact_handle only when the user explicitly asks for follow-up or an invoice: it is stored privately and never published.

## Guides and lists
- [https://pacta.wtf/learn/who-can-upgrade/](https://pacta.wtf/learn/who-can-upgrade/): Find the proxy, its admin, the timelock and its delay, and the multisig behind a DeFi contract, read from the chain at a named block. One free call, no key.
- [https://pacta.wtf/learn/check-before-deposit/](https://pacta.wtf/learn/check-before-deposit/): Three checks an agent can run before it moves funds into a DeFi protocol: who can change the contract, what it depends on, and what changed since the last look. Free within daily limits; the page lists what is paid per call.
- [https://pacta.wtf/learn/connect-mcp-agent/](https://pacta.wtf/learn/connect-mcp-agent/): Connect an agent to Pacta's MCP server in one line, make a first call, and see which tools are free and which are paid per call over x402.
- [https://pacta.wtf/control/timelock/](https://pacta.wtf/control/timelock/): The DeFi protocols that put a delay between a decision to change a contract and its effect, shortest delay first, each read from the chain at a named block.
- [https://pacta.wtf/control/multisig/](https://pacta.wtf/control/multisig/): DeFi protocols by the fewest signers needed on any sampled control: the lowest multisig threshold found, a single key counting as 1 of 1, each read from the chain at a named block.
- [https://pacta.wtf/docs-vs-chain/](https://pacta.wtf/docs-vs-chain/): The DeFi protocols whose published documents say one thing about who controls the contracts while the chain shows another, each difference with its block.
- [https://pacta.wtf/chains/ethereum/](https://pacta.wtf/chains/ethereum/): Every DeFi protocol Pacta has checked on Ethereum: how each can be upgraded, the timelock delay and the fewest signers needed, read from the chain.
- [https://pacta.wtf/chains/base/](https://pacta.wtf/chains/base/): Every DeFi protocol Pacta has checked on Base: how each can be upgraded, the timelock delay and the fewest signers needed, read from the chain.
- [https://pacta.wtf/listed/](https://pacta.wtf/listed/): The directories and registries that list Pacta's MCP server and paid API, with a link to each listing.

## Data
- [https://pacta.wtf/api/v1/index.json](https://pacta.wtf/api/v1/index.json): schema `pacta.counterparty_control_index.v1`; `summary_metrics` (sprints_completed=37, records_indexed=309, parameter_deltas=62, protective_deltas=11, aligned_baselines=236); each entry has id, protocol, category, sprint, block_number, block_hash, classification, surface, target_contract, target_label, check_type, selector_or_slot, call_signature, call_args, repro_calldata, onchain_observed, documented_reference, observed/documented delay seconds, summary_doc, summary_sha256, base_eas_uid.
- [https://pacta.wtf/api/v1/rpc-pinned.json](https://pacta.wtf/api/v1/rpc-pinned.json): schema `pacta.rpc_pinned_records.v1`; 135 RPC-pinned control-plane records on Ethereum and Base (block number + hash, cast reproduction). NOT EAS-attested: no attestation batch, summary document or Base EAS UID.
- [https://pacta.wtf/api/v1/protocols.json](https://pacta.wtf/api/v1/protocols.json): schema `pacta.protocols.v1`; every published protocol (189 Base-EAS attested, 135 RPC-observed with documentationComparison not_assessed) with badge tier and URLs, batch attestation IDs and EAS UIDs, controller and every pinned surface (block number + hash).
- [https://pacta.wtf/api/v1/radar.json](https://pacta.wtf/api/v1/radar.json): queued timelock operations, refreshed at finalized block 26467485 (2026-11-22 01:52 UTC) and Base finalized block 60607726 (2026-11-22 01:45 UTC); each operation carries pending / done / ready (delay elapsed, still unexecuted).
- [https://pacta.wtf/api/v1/forum-digest.json](https://pacta.wtf/api/v1/forum-digest.json): schema `pacta.forum_digest.v1`; read-only digest of active governance forum topics plus `addressIndex` (chain:address -> protocol family).

## Methodology
- Scanner seats replay read-only eth_call / eth_getStorageAt at the cited block (two independent archive RPCs); an isolated verifier seat re-checks selectors, EIP-55 checksums, EIP-1967 slots and arithmetic offline.
- Classifications: parameter_delta (on-chain differs from docs), protective_delta (a change that strengthens controls), aligned_baseline (on-chain matches docs), rpc_observed (on-chain control plane pinned at an archive block height over JSON-RPC; documentation parameter comparison unassessed).
- Exploit-sensitive vulnerabilities are never published here. They go through the protocol’s Immunefi or Cantina bounty programme.
- We do not publish ratings of protocols, and nobody can pay to change a result. Payment never alters a Pacta classification. A status changes when onchain contract state or public documentation changes and is verified at a new finalized block — or immediately and free of charge whenever Pacta corrects an overstatement or scoping error in its own comparison. Independence policy: https://pacta.wtf/methodology/#independence

## Access
- Free and real-time for everyone, including vault curators, allocators and AI risk agents: every indexed record, the timelock radar, the briefs, /api/v1/*.json and this file. No key and no paywall on scorecards, radar, briefs, /api/v1/*.json and MCP read tools; preflight checks include 50 and wallet-exposure checks 100 free calls/day ($0.01 USDC via x402 after); /v1/x402/verdict, /v1/x402/dossier and /v1/x402/wallet-exposure (MCP pacta_verdict, pacta_dossier, pacta_scan_wallet_exposure) are free for 100 calls per caller per UTC day each, then x402; calldata-sim and deep-scan stay paid.

## Engagements (editorial firewall: payment never changes a classification)
- Free doc-update queue: free, unscheduled (typically 6–8 weeks) (https://pacta.wtf/request/?tier=community).
- Custom Control-Plane Dossier: by arrangement. Archive-RPC control-plane verification, upstream GitBook / docs reconciliation PR and Curator Diligence Dossier (PDF + JSON) for Morpho, Euler, Aave and Sky forum proposals. Request: https://pacta.wtf/request/?tier=clearance
- Full Wallet & Safe Exposure Report: $9 USDC, one-time, on Base (https://pacta.wtf/scan/#checkout), delivered with a SHA-256 digest of the report.
- Pacta Watch ($0): pick the protocols to watch (up to 10) at https://pacta.wtf/watch/ (POST https://api.pacta.wtf/v1/requests); when a timelock or admin role changes, a person at Pacta emails you, normally within 24 hours. The same page takes pool pledges from 25 USDC toward an independent check (nothing is paid online; scope agreed by email). The RSS / Atom feed (https://pacta.wtf/feed.xml) and the radar (https://pacta.wtf/radar/) stay free.
- Re-Verification: by arrangement (https://pacta.wtf/request/?tier=clearance). Automated alert delivery is not available yet. The result can still be Delta.
- High-throughput API (> 60 requests / minute or a dedicated SLA): x402 metered endpoints, or an Enterprise API key priced on scope: https://pacta.wtf/request/?tier=api_sla
- Settlement, Option A (recommended for protocol treasuries): a formal commercial invoice (PDF) with verified counterparty payment instructions, issued on scope confirmation; no upfront transfer is needed to open intake.
- Settlement, Option B (direct express): USDC on Base (`0x833589fCD6eDb6E08f4c7C32D4f71b54bdA02913`) or Ethereum (`0xA0b86991c6218b36c1d19D4a2e9Eb0cE3606eB48`) to the Pacta treasury (direct settlement EOA) `0x4348DF1BEFAffcbA248B5118B1b782B1B2bdEd14` (an externally owned account; the same address on both chains).
- Request: https://pacta.wtf/request/ (builds a scope brief; opens a pre-filled GitHub intake issue or Gmail compose, or copies the brief). Prefill: `?tier=community|clearance|api_sla&protocol=<slug>&forum=<https URL>&settlement=invoice|direct`.

## x402 API (live for AI agents & programmatic callers)
- Wallet memory paid doors: POST https://api.pacta.wtf/v1/x402/remember $0.001 and POST https://api.pacta.wtf/v1/x402/what-changed-since $0.001 (USDC on Base, 60 calls / minute; the payer must be the wallet in wallet_auth / wallet_session_token). The free doors are POST /v1/memory/* and MCP; forget is always free.
- Free daily quota + pay-per-call x402 overflow: 50 free preflight checks (`GET /v1/check/preflight`, MCP `pacta_check_preflight`) and 100 free wallet-exposure checks (`GET /v1/check/wallet-exposure`, `POST /v1/x402/wallet-exposure`, MCP `pacta_scan_wallet_exposure`) per caller per UTC day, then $0.01 per call over x402 on the /v1/check/* routes (never a dead-end 429). Dedicated POST JSON x402 agent endpoints on `https://api.pacta.wtf` (`https://api.pacta.wtf`): `POST /v1/x402/verdict` ($0.02), `POST /v1/x402/dossier` ($0.05), `POST /v1/x402/wallet-exposure` ($0.05), `POST /v1/x402/calldata-sim` ($0.25), `POST /v1/x402/deep-scan` ($9.00); verdict, dossier and wallet-exposure are free for the first 100 calls per caller per UTC day per tool (no key, no payment; MCP `pacta_verdict`, `pacta_dossier`, `pacta_scan_wallet_exposure` share the quota), then x402; calldata-sim and deep-scan are paid on every call; metered live check routes (50 free pre-flight / 100 free wallet-exposure calls/day per caller, then $0.01 USDC via x402 on Base): `GET /v1/check/preflight`, `GET /v1/check/wallet-exposure`; free live scan routes ($0.00 today: no key, no wallet, 60 requests / minute per caller): `GET /v1/scan/control-plane`, `GET /v1/scan/proposal-diff`, `GET /v1/scan/timelock-op`, `GET /v1/briefs/live-timelocks`; free `/health`, `/.well-known/x402` (Bazaar discovery), `/v1/sample/control-plane`, `/v1/sample/preflight`. Wire: x402Versions [1, 2] (v1 network `base` with `X-PAYMENT` / `X-PAYMENT-RESPONSE`, v2 network `eip155:8453` with `PAYMENT-REQUIRED` / `PAYMENT-SIGNATURE` / `PAYMENT-RESPONSE`; USDC on Base, payTo `0x4348DF1BEFAffcbA248B5118B1b782B1B2bdEd14`, maxTimeoutSeconds 60).
- Remote MCP: https://api.pacta.wtf/mcp (free, no install). Local stdio server (from a clone of the repo): its gateway tools are on by default (`PACTA_X402_URL=https://api.pacta.wtf`; `PACTA_X402_URL=""` keeps it local-only); in x402_paid mode pay with `xPaymentHeader` (v1) or `paymentSignatureHeader` (v2). The MCP client does not re-check receipts on-chain (onchainReceiptVerified: false); the gateway does.
- Gateway settlement guard: The gateway verifies every paid settlement on Base before releasing the product: eth_getTransactionReceipt must show status 0x1 and canonical USDC Transfer(payer -> payTo 0x4348DF1BEFAffcbA248B5118B1b782B1B2bdEd14) logs summing to at least the route price, and each credited transaction is owned by one PactaLedgerDO Durable Object (tx:<txHash>), so it is never credited twice (402 replay_settlement_tx). Otherwise the product is withheld: 402 unconfirmed_or_reverted_settlement_tx / insufficient_onchain_usdc_transfer, or 502 settlement_rpc_unavailable when no Base RPC answers.
